description: List the quantitative ligand interactions for a protein target in the Guide to PHARMACOLOGY (IUPHAR/BPS). Given a GtoPdb target id (from search_targets), returns the ligands acting on it with interaction type (Agonist/Antagonist/Inhibitor/etc.), action, and binding affinity (e.g. pKi/pIC50). Keyless.

target_id.description: GtoPdb target id, e.g. 1797 for EGFR.

name: target_interactions
title: Target Interactions
